title: Temporarily disable SRD thaw-note gating until post-o9bd re-freeze
description: User decision (2026-07-02): the per-PR thaw-note requirement in verify-dnd5e-srd-freeze is creating unneeded churn and token spend while many o9bd epic beads remain before re-freeze. Disable ONLY the changed-path/thaw-note check behind a temporary flag; keep the hash-manifest check active. At re-freeze a new baseline will be established and the accumulated thaw notes squashed. Follow-up bead re-enables the gate at re-freeze.
close_reason: Merged to main in PR #384 (merge commit 70cb6c8). Thaw-note check disabled via THAW_NOTE_CHECK_ENABLED=false; hash check remains active. Re-enable tracked in eshyra-2zyy.
